entries.en:
As the disciplined domestic tells it, the map entrusted to you by Nanapasi will lead you to a buried stash of the age-old doll parts he requires to assemble the decorations he has promised his daughter.

Decipher the Thorne Dynasty map to reveal the location of the parts, then acquire them and deliver them to the disciplined domestic.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: The disciplined domestic rejoices at your success, assuring you that the parts that you have recovered will contribute greatly to the realization of Nanapasi's grand stage. Should the spirit of Little Ladies' Day strike you, continue to lend your aid to Nanapasi and his attendants, that the dreams of both father and daughter alike may come to fruition.

entries.en: Greetings, kind adventurer. On behalf of Master Nanapasi, allow me to express my most sincere gratitude for your cooperation in this matter.
entries.fr: Mon maître m'a mise au courant, ô brave aventuri<if(gnum4,ère,er)>. Laissez-moi, en son nom et le mien, vous remercier chaleureusement de votre aide.
entries.ja:
お話は聞いておりますわ、冒険者様。
我が主人ナナパシ様に代わって、お礼申し上げます。
ご協力、ありがとうございます。

entries.en: As you have heard from the man himself, my master seeks to assemble a modern-day recreation of the Little Ladies' Day decorations seen in the Thorne Dynasty days, as a special gift to his dear daughter Ninimo. Sadly, the task has proved a daunting one.
entries.fr: Le problème auquel nous nous trouvons confrontés est que nous manquons cruellement de documentation sur l'aspect des poupées de l'époque thornienne.
entries.ja:
「人形飾り」に関して、お願いしたいことですが……。
ナナパシ様からお聞きのとおり、進捗が思わしくないのは、
当時の人形が、ほとんど残されていないからなのです。

entries.en:
While tales of the dolls' beauty are many, actual descriptive records of the materials used and the means by which they were made are not so easily had. To further complicate things, the Thorne dolls were destroyed back when the Ul Dynasty came to power.
While this was doubtless done in order to sever cultural ties to the past and reinforce the Ul Dynasty's rule, it does not make our job any easier.

entries.fr: Lorsque la dynastie Thorne a laissé sa place à celle des Ul, ces poupées ont en effet été détruites, car elles étaient perçues comme un symbole d'attachement à la précédente cour.
entries.ja:
ウルダハがウル朝に変わる際、
ソーン朝様式の人形は、前王朝への忠誠を示すものとして、
徹底的に破棄されてしまった……。

entries.en: That said, all hope is not lost. It is said that among those tasked with the charge, there were those so smitten with the dolls' beauty that they simply could not bear to destroy them, instead concealing them outside of the city walls.
entries.fr: Néanmoins, certains membres de la haute société auraient outrepassé cet ordre et conservé secrètement ces objets auxquels ils accordaient une valeur par<->ti<->cu<->liè<->re.
entries.ja:
しかし、一部の者は愛着の湧いた人形を捨て去るには忍びなく、
人形を都市外のいずこかへと隠した、といわれます。

entries.en: If these stories are true, then my master's dream may yet be realized. Though the remnants will be too ancient to use as they are, any parts we could obtain would go far in allowing us to properly fashion our recreation.
entries.fr: Il se pourrait qu'il existe quelque part quelques-unes de ces poupées sauvées de la destruction et soigneusement cachées par ceux qui refusaient de détruire de tels joyaux... Il nous suffirait alors de les retrouver et de nous en inspirer.
entries.ja:
これが本当ならば、隠された人形飾りが、現存しているはず。
もちろん、古びてしまい、そのままでは使えないでしょう。
しかし、再現するための資料にはなります。

entries.en: As you know, my master intends to work with Miss Ninimo to transform the menagerie before us into a spectacle of beauty the likes of which Ul'dah has never seen! Should you be so inclined, we would welcome your continued assistance.
entries.fr: Comme vous le savez, le seigneur Nanapasi souhaite reproduire un présentoir à poupées grandeur réelle comme on en faisait à l'époque des Thorne. Si vous pouviez nous aider dans un de vos moments libres, cela nous serait d'un grand secours.

entries.en: This quest may be undertaken multiple times. The quantity of doll parts recovered in a given World will be reflected in the appearance of the doll stage, which will grow more and more extravagant over time.
entries.fr: Selon le nombre de fois que cette quête est effectuée dans ce Monde, les décorations seront de plus en plus belles et fournies.
